docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform role at Halden Pay. I have built and operated data pipelines and platform capabilities across payments and freight, with hands-on experience in Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Snowflake, and AWS.

At Lukovac Freight Hub, I own ingestion and orchestration for the data platform. I built a streaming pipeline handling around 30 million shipment events a day at under two minutes end-to-end latency at p95, and introduced dead-letter and replay tooling to support reliable recovery. I also migrated approximately 300 stored procedures to tested, documented dbt models, reducing the nightly warehouse build from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes. More recently, I replaced hourly full extracts with Debezium CDC and reduced replica CPU during loads from approximately 70% to 25%.

My earlier work at Kovalent Pay is especially relevant to Halden Pay’s payments business. I developed PySpark reconciliation jobs matching bank settlement files against internal ledgers, reducing month-end manual work for the finance team from approximately three days to four hours. I also bring a focus on dependable, maintainable data operations, including data quality checks, on-call platform support, and mentoring engineers. Halden Pay’s focus on reusable platform frameworks and ownership is a strong match for the kind of engineering work I have been doing.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building and improving production data platforms could contribute to Halden Pay’s Data Platform team.

Kind regards,
Lena Varga-Holm
